20300.name: Outside Of An Old Cave

east.description: To the east lies A Large Cave.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance Of An Old Cave.

20300.description:
Dry heat spills in from the large cave to the east, thinning to a stale,
musky warmth as it meets the breath of the tunnels. The floor is trodden
into a smooth hollow, scattered with gnawed splinters of bone and old
dark stains. Rough walls close in overhead, and the daylight behind you
shrinks to a pale smear. The passage leads west into the old cave, where
an acrid reek of lizard-musk drifts out to meet you.

20301.name: Entrance Of An Old Cave

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of An Old Cave.

east.description: To the east lies Outside Of An Old Cave.

20301.description:
The cave narrows to a throat of damp, sooty rock, its walls blackened by
years of smoky torches. A rank, reptilian stench hangs thick enough to
taste, and somewhere ahead water drips with slow patience. Deep claw-
marks score the stone beside the opening, many and overlapping. The
tunnel bends north into the dark, while the way east leads back toward
the pale light at the cave mouth.

20302.name: The Tunnel Of An Old Cave

north.description: To the north lies The Tunnel Of An Old Cave.

south.description: To the south lies Entrance Of An Old Cave.

20302.description:
The tunnel runs straight and low, so that a tall man must stoop beneath
the ridges of the ceiling. The floor is gritty with sand carried in on
many scaly feet, and a line of greasy handprints smears the wall at
shoulder height. Warm, sour air creeps along the passage from the north,
while the way south leads back to the cave's entrance. Far off,
something clinks like a chain being dragged.

20303.name: The Tunnel Of An Old Cave

north.description: To the north lies Fork In The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of An Old Cave.

20303.description:
Here the tunnel widens a little and the rock turns from grey to a rusty
red, veined with pale seams that glint dully in the gloom. Puddles of
foul water have gathered in the dips of the floor, ringed with a
greenish scum. The reek of lizard flesh is stronger now, and a guttural
muttering rolls down the passage from the north. Behind you the way
south slopes gently back toward the entrance.

20304.name: Fork In The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

east.description: To the east lies Meeting Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies The Tunnel Of An Old Cave.

20304.description:
The tunnel splits at a ragged hub of broken rock, beneath a ceiling
black with soot. To the east a ruddy glow and the grunting of many
throats mark the Meeting Chamber, and a cold draught breathes down from
the north, where the floor gives way to a thin ledge over a chasm. A
heap of splintered crates leans against one wall, long since looted. The
passage south leads back down toward the old cave's entrance.

20305.name: Meeting Chamber

north.description: To the north lies Meat Locker.

east.description: To the east lies Guard Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Troglodyte Barracks.

west.description: To the west lies Fork In The Tunnel.

20305.description:
A wide, ragged chamber where the troglodytes gather to bark their
council, its floor tamped hard by clawed feet. A ring of stone slabs
serves as seats around a fire-pit still smouldering with greasy coals,
and the walls are black with soot. Painted lizard-glyphs in red ochre
march across the rock. A tunnel leads west to the fork, a low passage
north to the meat locker, a hide-curtained way east to another guard
chamber, and a heavy door south to the barracks.

20306.name: Troglodyte Barracks

north.description: To the north lies Meeting Chamber.

20306.description:
Row upon row of filthy pallets crowd this long, low room, each a nest of
reeds and rotting skins. Clawed handholds climb the walls, and weapons
of crude bronze and bone hang from pegs beside every bed. The heat and
the reek of many bodies are suffocating, and the roof drips with
condensation. The only way out is the door north, back to the meeting
chamber.

20307.name: Meat Locker

south.description: To the south lies Meeting Chamber.

20307.description:
Rusted hooks hang from the low ceiling of this hot, narrow cell, and
gutters cut in the floor run thick with dark fluid. The walls are
stained brown, and flies hang in clouds in the stifling air. A great
chopping block, hacked to a ragged dish in its middle, stands against
the wall. The stench is almost unbearable, and the only way out is
south.

20308.name: Guard Chamber

east.description: To the east lies Giant's Lair.

west.description: To the west lies Meeting Chamber.

20308.description:
A broad guardroom with a roof of dark, smoke-stained rock, kept by those
who serve the giant beyond. Heavy spears lean in racks beside the wall,
and a stout table of split planks is scarred with knife cuts and gnawed
knuckles of bone. Dice carved from teeth lie where a game was left. A
massive door of timber and iron stands in the east wall, and the way
west leads back to the meeting chamber.

20309.name: Giant's Lair

west.description: To the west lies Guard Chamber.

20309.description:
A vast cavern, its roof lost in darkness, where a giant has made his
home. A bed of stripped hides and straw the size of a cart fills one
end, and a boulder serves as a table, piled with gnawed bones. Pillars
of rock the thickness of old oaks rise into the gloom, scratched with
crude tallies. The air is rank and hot, and the only way out is the
great door to the west.

20310.name: A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

south.description: To the south lies Fork In The Tunnel.

20310.description:
The floor narrows here to a shelf of rock barely wider than your boots,
with the wall rough at your shoulder and nothing at all on the other
side. A cold updraught rises from the chasm, carrying the smell of damp
stone and a dizzying emptiness. Pebbles shaken loose by your steps
skitter over the edge and fall a long time before any sound returns.
Behind you to the south the tunnel fork waits, and the ledge creeps on
north.

20312.name: A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm

north.description: To the north lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

south.description: To the south lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

down.description: To the down lies Almost Falling Down The Deep Chasm.

20312.description:
The ledge crumbles badly here, its outer lip eaten away so that you must
press your back to the wall and shuffle sideways. Far below, a faint
pale glimmer marks the chasm floor, and a slick, steep slope of wet rock
falls away into the gloom beneath your feet. Damp rises from the depths
and beads on the stone like sweat. The ledge continues north and south
along the wall, and a descent down is possible for the desperate or the
foolish.

20313.name: A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm

north.description: To the north lies A Tunnel In The Mountain.

south.description: To the south lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

20313.description:
The ledge broadens at last into a shelf wide enough to stand on without
clinging, and the wall curves in to meet an arched opening. Old iron
pegs, rusted to stubs, are driven into the stone where a rope rail once
ran. The chasm still gapes at your side, its depths hissing with the
thin echo of wind. South the ledge winds back toward the fork, and a
tunnel mouth lies north in the flank of the mountain.

20314.name: A Tunnel In The Mountain

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Gnome Silver Mine.

south.description: To the south lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

20314.description:
A square-cut tunnel bores into the heart of the mountain, its walls
chiselled smooth by patient gnomish hands and its floor laid with worn
flagstones. Shallow grooves run along the middle where the carts of the
mine once rattled. Soot and old tallow drippings mark the places where
lamps hung, though none burn now. The way north leads on toward the
gnome silver mine proper, and the ledge over the chasm lies back south.

20315.name: Entrance To The Gnome Silver Mine

south.description: To the south lies A Tunnel In The Mountain.

west.description: To the west lies A Bend In The Mine's Tunnels.

20315.description:
A great arch of fitted stone frames the entrance, its keystone carved
with a gnome's pick and lantern worn almost smooth. Beyond it the mine
opens into broad galleries propped with timber, black with age and
gnawed by damp. Broken lamp-brackets hang from the walls, and troglodyte
filth is smeared across the old carvings in dark streaks. The tunnel
leads west into the workings, and back south toward the chasm.

20316.name: A Bend In The Mine's Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies A Tunnel In The Mine.

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Gnome Silver Mine.

20316.description:
The tunnel bends sharply here, the timber props leaning wearily as
though tired of holding up the mountain. Veins of dull silver run
through the rock in thin threads, catching what faint light leaks in
from somewhere. Scraps of rag and rotten rope litter the corners, and
the air is thick with heat and the sour-sweet reek of the creatures that
now hold these workings. The tunnel runs north into the deeper mine, and
east toward the entrance arch.

20317.name: A Tunnel In The Mine

north.description: To the north lies More Tunnels In The Silver Mine.

south.description: To the south lies A Bend In The Mine's Tunnels.

20317.description:
A long straight gallery stretches on, the roof held by a rank of squared
beams scored with the marks of picks and claws alike. A shallow ditch
along one wall was meant to carry water away, but now it holds a black
sludge that stinks of rot. A wrecked handcart lies on its side near the
wall, its wheels long since torn off. The mine continues north, and the
bend lies back to the south.

20318.name: More Tunnels In The Silver Mine

north.description: To the north lies More Tunnels In The Mine.

east.description: To the east lies Passage To The Guard Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies A Tunnel In The Mine.

20318.description:
Several side-cuts open off the gallery here, though most have been
choked with rubble and rough barricades of splintered timber. Scratch-
marks on the stone count off days in groups of five, left by some
prisoner long ago. A trail of drag marks wanders east along the floor
into a passage toward the guard chamber. The silver mine's main tunnel
goes on north and back south.

20319.name: Chamber Of Cells

north.description: To the north lies Outside Of A Cell.

east.description: To the east lies Outside Of A Cell.

south.description: To the south lies Outside Of A Cell.

west.description: To the west lies Passage To The Guard Chamber.

20319.description:
This hot, stinking hub has three short passages leading north, east and
south toward the rows of cell doors. A fire-pit of cold ash and
blackened bones squats in the centre of the floor, ringed with rough
stools. Iron rings in the walls hold the ends of long chains, and the
air is heavy with sweat and smoke. The way west returns along the low
passage to the mine.

20320.name: Outside Of A Cell

north.description: To the north lies Inside A Cell.

south.description: To the south lies Chamber Of Cells.

20320.description:
A short stub of passage ends at a heavy door of rust-crusted bars,
filthy with years of handling. A hook beside it holds an empty key-ring,
and wet streaks run down the wall below a leaking seam in the stone. The
door north leads into the cell, while the passage south opens back to
the chamber of cells.

20321.name: Inside A Cell

south.description: To the south lies Outside Of A Cell.

20321.description:
A cramped cell hewn into the rock, scarcely long enough to lie down in.
An iron ring is set into the floor, and a rust-eaten pail crusted with
filth sits in one corner. Fingernail gouges mark the stone beside a heap
of mouldering straw, and the heat is close and wet as a breath. The
barred door opens south onto the passage outside.

20322.name: Outside Of A Cell

east.description: To the east lies Inside A Cell.

west.description: To the west lies Chamber Of Cells.

20322.description:
The passage here is a narrow, sweating throat of stone ending in a low
door of black timber, bolted on the outside. Dark drips fall from a
crack in the roof and have stained a long streak down the wall. A smell
of old fish and trodden straw hangs over everything. The door leads east
into a cell, and the passage west opens back into the chamber of cells.

20323.name: Inside A Cell

west.description: To the west lies Outside Of A Cell.

20323.description:
This cell is the smallest of the three, a squat box of rock with a
ceiling you can touch. A chain hangs from a staple in the wall, its last
link worn bright by a struggling wrist. The straw on the floor is matted
into a nest and alive with crawling things. Faint light seeps under the
door, which opens west to the passage.

20324.name: Outside Of A Cell

north.description: To the north lies Chamber Of Cells.

south.description: To the south lies Inside A Cell.

20324.description:
Here the passage ends in a bare stub of floor, its walls gouged by the
careless swing of chains. A heap of broken manacles lies in one corner,
rusted to the colour of dried blood. The door south is a slab of iron-
studded wood with a grated peephole at head height. North, the passage
runs back into the stifling chamber of cells.

20325.name: Inside A Cell

north.description: To the north lies Outside Of A Cell.

20325.description:
A narrow, windowless cell, hot as an oven and thick with the smell of
old sweat. Names have been picked into the wall in rows with something
sharp, and a pale handprint is pressed in the soot beside them. Bones of
some small animal lie scattered in the straw. The only way out is north,
through the door to the passage.

20326.name: More Tunnels In The Mine

north.description: To the north lies Crossroads In The Silver Mine.

south.description: To the south lies More Tunnels In The Silver Mine.

20326.description:
The gallery climbs a little, its floor gritty with crushed spar and
flecks of silver that wink in whatever light there is. A miner's lantern
lies smashed against the wall, its glass ground to powder underfoot.
Heat gathers close beneath the ceiling, and the rock sweats with it.
North the tunnel lifts toward a crossing of ways, and south it falls
back toward the lower workings.

20327.name: Crossroads In The Silver Mine

north.description: To the north lies Deep Mining Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Slave Pen.

south.description: To the south lies More Tunnels In The Mine.

west.description: To the west lies Mining Tunnel.

20327.description:
Four tunnels meet at this crossing, the timber lintel of each blackened
by smoke. Worn grooves in the floor show where ore carts once turned,
though now boot-prints and the long drag of tails mark the dust instead.
To the east a heavy door of iron-banded wood, stained and splintered,
leads into the slave pen. A wide tunnel runs west, another north into
the deep workings, and the way south returns to the upper mine.

20328.name: Slave Pen

west.description: To the west lies Crossroads In The Silver Mine.

20328.description:
Iron bars bolted into the rock divide this reeking pen into narrow
stalls, each with a heap of filthy straw and a ring driven into the
wall. The air is thick with heat, urine and despair, and chains clink
faintly whenever the draught stirs them. Names, tally marks and a few
half-finished prayers are scratched into the stone. The only way out is
west, through the heavy door to the crossing.

extra_descs.names scratches tally marks:
Hundreds of tally marks and a handful of names, some in gnomish script
and some in the common tongue, are scratched into the stone. The newest
are fresh and pale.

20329.name: Mining Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Crossroads In The Silver Mine.

west.description: To the west lies A Section Of A Mining Tunnel.

20329.description:
A narrower tunnel runs off from the crossing, its roof so low that the
support beams brush your hair. The rock is cut with long, careful
gnomish chisel strokes, but a black fungus has crept over them in
patches. Sour water trickles down one wall into a dark puddle. The
tunnel returns east to the crossing and runs on west into the dark,
where the air grows cooler and stranger.

20330.name: A Section Of A Mining Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Mining Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Mining Tunnel.

20330.description:
A section of the roof has partly collapsed here, and a slope of broken
stone spills across the floor, leaving only a narrow track beside it.
Dust drifts down in thin streams from the cracks above. The old support
beams are cracked and bowed, and someone has scratched a crooked gnomish
rune on the nearest. West the tunnel runs toward a quieter place, and
east it leads back toward the crossing.

20331.name: A Mining Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Section Of A Mining Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Tomb Of A Gnome King.

20331.description:
The tunnel is cool and strangely clean here, as if the troglodytes shun
the place. The walls are dressed with fine gnomish masonry, and small
stone lamps stand in recesses along them, all long cold. At the end of
the passage a door of grey stone, carved with a crowned gnome beneath a
pickaxe, leads west. East the tunnel returns toward the dark, rank
reaches of the mine.

20332.name: Tomb Of A Gnome King

east.description: To the east lies A Mining Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies The Lost Tomb Of King Lindon.

20332.description:
A hushed vault of pale stone, where a great sarcophagus lies on a dais
under a canopy of dust and cobwebs. Carved gnomes bearing picks and
lamps stand in ranks along the walls, their faces worn by time. The
floor is dry and cold, and a narrow stair spirals down through a gap in
it. The stone door to the east leads out to the tunnel, and silence
presses in.

extra_descs.sarcophagus dais:
The lid of the sarcophagus is carved with a stern gnome crowned in
silver-inlaid stone, and the runes at its foot name him a king of the
deep delvings. Cobwebs hang from it in grey sheets.

20333.name: The Lost Tomb Of King Lindon

up.description: To the up lies Tomb Of A Gnome King.

20333.description:
Below the royal vault lies the true resting place, a small round chamber
of black stone sealed from the world for centuries. A stone bier stands
in the centre, the carved figure of a bearded king laid upon it in full
armour, hands crossed over a pickaxe. Tiny silver studs set in the
ceiling mimic stars and gleam faintly. Dust lies undisturbed on every
surface, and a narrow stair leads up to the vault above.

20334.name: Deep Mining Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Fork In The Deep Mining Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Crossroads In The Silver Mine.

20334.description:
The tunnel burrows deep now, and the heat is a heavy hand pressing on
your chest. Sweat and stale smoke hang in the air, and the walls glisten
with a slick of condensation. Pale seams of silver ore stripe the rock,
hacked at crudely where the troglodytes have ripped out what they could.
The deep tunnel runs north toward a fork, and south toward the crossing.

20335.name: Fork In The Deep Mining Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies End Of The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies Guard Chamber.

south.description: To the south lies Deep Mining Tunnel.

20335.description:
Two pillars of left-standing rock divide the tunnel into rough ways. To
the east a lamp-lit opening leads into the guard chamber, and the
clatter of armour and low growls spill out of it. North the deep tunnel
runs on to a dead end, and the south way leads back to the long gallery.
Fresh claw-slashes score the pillars at head height, and the floor is
stained with old blood.

20336.name: Guard Chamber

east.description: To the east lies Treasure Vault.

west.description: To the west lies Fork In The Deep Mining Tunnel.

20336.description:
This squat room is hacked square from the rock, its low ceiling black
with the smoke of cooking fires. Crude pallets of dry reeds and foul
skins line the walls, and a broad table made from an old door stands
crusted with spilled meat. A heavy door of black iron in the east wall,
thick with bolts, guards the vault beyond. West the room opens back onto
the fork in the tunnel.

20337.name: Treasure Vault

west.description: To the west lies Guard Chamber.

20337.description:
A cramped vault carved into the living rock, where the troglodytes hoard
what they have stolen from gnomes and travellers. Split chests and
broken shelves sag under tarnished plunder, and a few silver gleams
catch in the dusk. The air is close and dry, smelling of dust and cold
metal. The only way out is the iron door, back west into the guard
chamber.

20338.name: End Of The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies Fork In The Deep Mining Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies Chamber Of The Slave Master.

20338.description:
The tunnel ends in a blunt wall of raw rock, but the floor has been cut
away into a rough stair that drops through a hole in the stone. A thick,
hot reek rises from below, smelling of old sweat, lamp oil and the tang
of iron. A rusted ring hangs in the wall, a few links of cut chain
dangling from it. The tunnel returns south, while the stair leads down
into a lower chamber.

20339.name: Chamber Of The Slave Master

up.description: To the up lies End Of The Tunnel.

20339.description:
This low, sweating chamber is the den of the slave master. A massive
wooden block, scarred and darkened, stands in the middle of the floor,
with a rack of whips and cruel hooks bolted to the wall beside it.
Chains lie coiled in heaps, and the stone is stained brown in wide
patches. A lamp of rancid fat gutters on a ledge, throwing long shadows.
The only way out is up the rough stair.

20340.name: Almost Falling Down The Deep Chasm

up.description: To the up lies A Thin Ledge Going Through A Chasm.

down.description: To the down lies Outside A Cave.

20340.description:
You hang on a crack-ridden face of rock where the chasm plunges away,
your fingers wedged in seams slick with damp. Above, the thin ledge is a
pale line against the dark. Below, the walls fall away into a wider
gloom where something faintly glows. The way up leads back to the ledge,
and the way down is a long, sliding scramble toward the chasm floor.

20341.name: Outside A Cave

north.description: To the north lies Room Of The Queen Puffer Spider.

up.description: To the up lies Almost Falling Down The Deep Chasm.

20341.description:
The chasm floor is a tumble of broken rock and drifts of fallen grit,
hazed with cold mist. Long ropes of grey web hang from the crags and
sway in the draught, sticky with dust and the husks of small creatures.
The stone is chalky with droppings, and the air smells of musk and rot.
A cave mouth opens in the rock to the north, strung with thick webbing,
and the climb leads up the rock face.

20342.name: Room Of The Queen Puffer Spider

north.description: To the north lies Breeding Room.

south.description: To the south lies Outside A Cave.

20342.description:
A high, rounded cavern, its roof drooping with sheets of silk as thick
as sailcloth. The floor is carpeted in old webbing and brittle leavings,
crunching underfoot, and heavy strands run from wall to wall like the
rigging of a ship. A sour, chemical stink hangs in the still air, and
the stone is slick with a clear, tacky fluid. South lies the cave mouth,
and a darker chamber opens to the north.

20343.name: Breeding Room

south.description: To the south lies Room Of The Queen Puffer Spider.

20343.description:
Pale sacs the size of barrels cling to the walls and floor of this warm,
damp chamber, packed together in glistening clusters. Webs bind them
like ropes, and a faint pulsing stirs inside the nearest. The air is
humid and clinging, smelling of musk and sweet decay. The only way out
is south, back through the queen's room.

extra_descs.sacs egg sacs:
The sacs are tough and translucent, and dark shapes curl within. They
twitch whenever you step near.

20344.name: Passage To The Guard Chamber

east.description: To the east lies Chamber Of Cells.

west.description: To the west lies More Tunnels In The Silver Mine.

20344.description:
A short, low passage joins the mine to the cells, its roof studded with
hooks from which lanterns once swung. The stench of unwashed bodies and
sour sweat grows with each step, and the clink of chains comes steadily
from the east. Smears of old blood mark the walls at hip height. The
passage runs west back to the main gallery and east into the chamber of
cells.

642600.name: troglodyte scavenger lizard
642600.long_desc: A skulking troglodyte scavenger picks through the filth, hissing softly to itself.
642600.description:
This scaly, mottled creature stands hunched and long-armed, its yellow
eyes darting about. A ridge of spines runs down its back and a sour musk
rolls off its hide. It carries a chipped knife in one clawed hand.

642601.name: troglodyte warrior lizard
642601.long_desc: A hulking troglodyte warrior prowls the gloom, its spiked club dragging across the stone.
642601.description:
Tall and muscular, this troglodyte has a hide the colour of old bruises
and a crest of bone running over its skull. Its rank body-stench makes
the eyes water, and it grips a knobbed club with an easy cruelty.

642602.name: cave lizard pale
642602.long_desc: A pale cave lizard clings to the wall, its blind head swaying from side to side.
642602.description:
The lizard is as long as a man's leg, bone-white and eyeless, with a
tongue that tastes the air in flicks. Its jaws are lined with small,
hooked teeth.

642603.name: troglodyte warden guard lizard
642603.long_desc: A scarred troglodyte warden stands guard, a heavy shield strapped to its arm.
642603.description:
This troglodyte is broader and darker than its fellows, its scales
crossed with old scars and iron studs hammered into its crest. It
carries a spiked shield and a notched cleaver, and it watches with the
flat patience of a veteran jailer.

642604.name: puffer spider giant swollen
642604.long_desc: A swollen puffer spider hangs in its web, its bloated abdomen pulsing slowly.
642604.description:
The spider is the size of a calf, its body a pale, bloated sac patterned
with dark whorls. Eight eyes glint in a bristling head, and each leg
ends in a hooked claw. A fine mist of spores seeps from it when it
moves.

642605.name: vorzug slave master troglodyte
642605.long_desc: Vorzug the Slave Master stands over his block, a barbed lash coiled in his fist.
642605.description:
Vorzug is a gaunt, long-limbed troglodyte whose hide is crosshatched
with the scars of his own trade. A necklace of broken shackle links
rattles on his chest, and his yellow stare never leaves you. The lash in
his hand is wet with old blood.

642606.name: hrungar hill giant
642606.long_desc: Hrungar the hill giant squats amid the bones of his meals, glaring down at all who enter.
642606.description:
Hrungar is a mountain of grey, warty flesh, twice the height of a man,
with a jaw like a quarry slab. Matted hair hangs in his eyes, and he
hefts a club made from the trunk of an old tree. The troglodytes feed
him their captives in exchange for his protection.

742600.name: hide vest scaly troglodyte
742600.room_desc: A scaly hide vest lies here, reeking of musk.
742600.description: A crude vest stitched from lizard hide, stiff and ridged with small bony plates. It smells foul, but it turns a blade well enough.

742601.name: spiked shield warden iron
742601.room_desc: A spiked iron shield lies here, dented and stained.
742601.description: A round shield of beaten iron, its boss ringed with crude spikes. Old blood is crusted in the dents.

742602.name: silk cloak pale puffer
742602.room_desc: A pale silk cloak lies here, shimmering faintly.
742602.description: A cloak spun from spider silk, light as a breath and surprisingly strong. It shimmers like frost in poor light.

742603.name: barbed lash whip slave
742603.room_desc: A barbed lash lies coiled here.
742603.description: A long whip of braided hide, with small iron barbs knotted along its length. The handle is wrapped with a strip of old shackle chain.

742604.name: giant bone club tree
742604.room_desc: A giant's gnarled club lies here, as heavy as a young tree.
742604.description: A club hewn from an old tree trunk, studded with gnawed knuckle bones and iron spikes. A man needs both arms and a stout back just to lift it.
